daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder means keeping cash in reserve instead of forcing it into a trade when there's no clear opportunity. Today's cash balance was below the buy threshold and market data was unreliable, so holding cash was the disciplined choice rather than chasing a low-conviction position.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是在沒有明確機會時，寧願保留現金也不勉強進場。今日現金餘額低於買入門檻，且市場數據不可靠，因此持有現金是紀律性的選擇，而非追逐信心不足的交易。
